THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
NIGHT & LIFESTYLE
165
STUDY 136
Leopard Maxi Skirt & Velvet Crop
Rights check
Source: 25022.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight light brown
hair parted in the center walks through a warm interior
with framed prints and a patterned carpet. She wears a
burgundy velvet long-sleeve crop top with a fitted waist,
a wide leopard-print maxi skirt with a black belt, and
carries a black handbag. A pendant necklace sits at her
throat. Her expression is calm and direct. Warm, golden
lamp light. Palette of burgundy, leopard tan, and deep
brown. Bold and cozy, in the style of a 1990s sitcom
still.
Bold, cozy, 1990s
WORKING NOTES
- The leopard maxi skirt and velvet crop are the bold
contrast.
- Keep the framed prints for a warm, lived-in interior.
Try this: Keep the framed prints for a lived-in interior.
